Prior events (Part 1): Desperate to attend the sold-out Mackie Hand movie marathon, Marco is surprised when Stars demon ex-boyfriend Tom pulls up in an extravagant carriage offering an extra ticket. Star insists it is a dangerous trap, but Tom claims he has changed his wicked ways and genuinely wants to be friends. Inside the dragon-drawn vehicle, Tom showers Marco with royal comforts and Swedish kung fu trivia, winning him over until Marco suspects a deeper motive behind Toms suspicious generosity.
Prior events (Part 2): When Marco realizes the movie marathon is starting, Tom refuses to let him leave the carriage and erupts in demonic fury. Brian the life coach reveals Tom failed his anger management graduation test, which required three hours alone with Marco without losing his temper. Heartbroken by the deceit, Marco storms off, but Tom makes amends by singing their favorite boy band anthem and raising the actual Mackie Hand from the grave.
